golden.code: from skyfield.api import load_file; from skyfield import api; ts=api.load.timescale(builtin=True); eph=load_file('artifacts/de421.bsp'); t=ts.tt_jd(2451545.0); ra,dec,dist=eph['earth'].at(t).observe(eph['mars']).radec(); f'{round(ra._degrees,4)} {round(dec.degrees,4)} {round(dist.au,6)}'
